note.question: What determines the pricing problem faced by a revenue-maximizing platform matching price-sensitive customers to flexible supply units within a geographic area?
note.overview: The model considers the pricing problem faced by a revenue-maximizing platform matching price-sensitive customers to flexible supply units within a geographic area. This can be interpreted as the problem faced in the short term by a ride-hailing platform. The paper proposes a two-dimensional framework in which a platform selects prices for different locations and drivers respond by choosing where to relocate, in equilibrium, based on prices, travel costs, and driver congestion levels.
